has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile's website field points only to a square.site booking page (heritageinktattoocompany.square.site), a booking platform, which does not count as an own domain per pipeline rules. The square.site page itself (fetched directly) has no services, prices, hours or contact info beyond the business name, location and 'Walk-ins Welcome / Appointments available'. WebSearch for the business name plus 'email contact Artie' returned only unrelated Jacksonville tattoo shops, none matching.
email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (phone only), the square.site booking page (fetched directly, no email shown), and WebSearch for the business name plus contact terms. Phone is the only confirmed public contact channel; outreach registered as pending_manual.

services.source: Derived from verbatim Google reviews naming artist Artie, the square.site booking page ('Walk-ins Welcome / Appointments available'), and the business's own Google photos spanning realism (lion and lamb, American flag), color (skull and roses, tarot card) and fine line (floral) work. Nothing invented.
services.pricing_note: No price list found publicly. Site uses the adapted variant: every piece is quoted, call for a price, nothing invented. 'Walk-ins welcome, appointments also available' is real, confirmed text from the booking page.

reviews_verbatim.name: Amanda Coleman
reviews_verbatim.text: Amazing place! My husband and I both got tattoos and they turned out perfect. The owners and our artist are such great people, friendly, honest, respectful. The shop was clean and welcoming. If you're looking for an awesome tattoo this is the place to go.

reviews_verbatim.name: Lydia Johnson
reviews_verbatim.text: I had a wonderful experience. Family oriented, Artie is an amazing artist. I got my 1st ever finger tattoos, barely felt anything. Amazing work, amazing atmosphere! Highly recommend!!

reviews_verbatim.name: Ieshia
reviews_verbatim.text: We had such a great experience at Heritage Ink Tattoo Company! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming, and everyone was incredibly friendly. The entire shop had a great vibe that made us feel comfortable and at ease...

reviews_note: 3 real verbatim Google reviews (1 truncated at Google's own preview length) out of 29 total, collected via scripts/maps_research.py. Artist name 'Artie' confirmed directly from the Lydia Johnson review.
